name: switch
need: Turn a setting on or off, alone or in a list of settings

--ds-switch-halo.description: the halo around the switch handle: the base, 8px per size step

--ds-switch-track-height.description: the track: the base height, 4px per size step; the width (13 : 8), the handle, its travel and the icon follow

--ds-switch-height.description: the smallest height of a switch row: the base that size and density steps apply to

--ds-switch-list-row-height.description: the smallest row of a `.ds-switch-list`: the base that size and density steps apply to

--ds-switch-disabled-track.description: disabled switch track (and border) and off handle

--ds-switch-disabled-handle.description: disabled switch track (and border) and off handle

physical..ds-switch__track::after: left: the handle starts at the left and travels on translate
physical..ds-switch__track::before: left: the halo starts at the left and travels on translate with the handle

press..ds-switch:active input:not(:disabled, [: the handle grows to its pressed size
press..ds-switch.ds-pressed input:not(:disable: the handle grows to its pressed size
